Tamil Nadu challenges High Court order on hill lamp lighting in Supreme Court

The Tamil Nadu government has filed a petition in the Supreme Court challenging a High Court order that permitted the lighting of a lamp atop Thiruparankundram hill. The High Court's decision allowed for the Karthigai Deepam ritual to be performed on the hill. The state government's move to the apex court indicates a legal dispute over religious practices at the site.
